reader.notes: Acceptance and refusal match the rule in every form probed. LEAD (diagnostic text only, harm misleads-diagnosis, no kb/Work note found): at --std 85, COBOL1637 from SubscriptBinder.cs#IndexNameInPositionError says '§1985:VI.5.8.3 SR13 makes both bounds arithmetic expressions' and speaks of 'SR13's five contexts'; the inline ed.Cite("§1985:VI.5.8.3 SR13", "§2023:8.4.3.3.3 SR4") should cite §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.3 SR2, and IndexNameRule.cs#Contexts' 1985 arm names a rule (OCCURS SR13: an index-name 'not being data') that lists no contexts. Repro: probes/src/n03index.cob at --std 85; at 2023 the text is right. The probe header's PIC Z9 VALUE 2 also drew COBOL0900 at 85, which is outside this rule and was removed in the b reruns.

refuter.evidence: Refusal attack from §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5 (a refmod of a numeric item is class alphanumeric, so not an arithmetic-expression operand): W(N(1:1):1) and W(1:N(2:1)) both refused COBOL0844 citing GR2/VI.6.2.1 (runs/x01-001, x02-001); alphanumeric function refmod W(FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE(1:1):1) refused COBOL0844 (x03-001); condition-name W(C88:1) refused COBOL1639 (x04-001); HIGH-VALUE and QUOTE refused COBOL2363 (x05-001, x06-001); a 2002 function FUNCTION BYTE-LENGTH at 85 refused COBOL1502 (x07-001). Acceptance (a01-002, EXIT 0): COMP and PACKED-DECIMAL and BINARY items (D1 BCD D), integer function LENGTH (D2 J), NUMVAL with ZEROES + 2 (D3 BC), index-subscripted numeric items in both positions (D4 BCD), ZEROS (D5 BCD), MOD and unary operators (D6 CD), ORD-MAX (D7 BC). cite.py: 'OK  §1985:IV.4.3.8.4.4 GR5 ... the text is in GR5'; 'OK  §1985:VI.6.2.1 ... it lies in p1 ... the figurative constant ZERO (ZEROS, ZEROES)'. Side finding outside this rule: W(FUNCTION MOD(7, 4):- 2 * - 1) is refused COBOL2993 (unary minus right after the colon); §1985:VI.6.2.2 requires a space before the operator, so the refusal follows the text. The reader's LEAD (COBOL1637 at 85 cites §1985:VI.5.8.3 SR13, SubscriptBinder.cs line 1040 and IndexNameRule.cs) is confirmed in source; it is diagnostic text only and does not change acceptance or refusal.
